text:
My baby cat died here yesterday after she stopped breathing when they did a leg surgery. Despite the loss and my absolute heavy heart I have to make this review because anything else wouldn’t be fair. I believe that everyone’s time will come and yesterday it was time for my little cat to thrive to heaven.

This clinic is really outstanding and they have done a great job. From the first moment we came with our little cat Nazare they have tried everything to make sure she gonna be fine. They treated her very well and they were available for calls due out the whole day. Unfortunately they had to tell us that Nazare didn’t make it but even tho the surgery was already fully finished and she did after, they gave me all the money back without even asking for it.

If you have animals and need them to take care of this is a fantastic place to go and I would always go back here if I have another animal. Rest in peace my little baby 🕊️❤️

Our second visit was for routine vaccinations for our pet cat, and everything went perfectly.

I highly recommend Vetmed Animal Hospital for its outstanding service and compassionate care.

restaurant_name: Vetmed Animal Hospital Phuket (โรงพยาบาลสัตว์เว็ทเมดภูเก็ต)
text:
I rescued two 4-month-old kittens, Bob and Agnes, after their mother was hit by a car two weeks ago. I found them in a garage where my friend was working on his car. This same friend, who lives in Rawai, recommended Vetmed Animal Hospital in Phuket, and it turned out to be the best decision ever.

After a blood test, it was revealed that both kittens had parvovirus, and one had mild FIV. The Vetmed team took exceptional care of Bob and Agnes, providing condition reports with pictures and videos at least three times a day. Their genuine passion for helping animals was evident, and they treated Bob and Agnes with incredible kindness. I would have loved for Vetmed to continue caring for them, but I live up north in Choeng Thale, so I had to bring them home after four days of being admitted.

The doctor at Vetmed prepared all the necessary referral letters for me to take Bob and Agnes to a local vet to continue their treatment. As a first-time pet owner with no experience in looking after kittens, I was grateful for Vetmed’s ongoing support. They continue to reply to all my questions and even call to check on the kittens post-discharge.

I am deeply grateful for their kindness and care for Bob and Agnes. I highly recommend Vetmed to any pet owners living in the Rawai and Chalong areas.

text:
If your animal has a serious condition I recommend you take it to another more equipped hospital.
I brought my dog here after she was run over by a scooter, she was in incredible pain.
They did X-rays and Ultrasound scan and told me they could not see anything wrong internally.
They gave her a pain injection.
She would not walk.
The next day I took her back here as I was clearly worried and they gave her another pain injection, 1 hr later she died in my arms.
She lasted 46hrs but I know in my heart she could have been saved if they had not been so incompetent.
As a consequence of losing my dog and the associated grief I also lost my girlfriend of 4yrs we were due to get married.
The loss caused grief beyond words.
My life has been ruined.
I know they missed something on the scans and they should have been honest and told me they were not equipped to deal with the situation and I would have taken her to a more professional place.
I will forever regret bringing my dog here and will always wish I had taken her to a proper animal hospital where they would have admitted her and monitored her.
All I got from this animal clinic were empty assurances and a dead dog.
